title: A second workspace lockfile changes without its own decision record (monorepo rider)

prerequisites: A malicious PR author in a monorepo with more than one lockfile
attacker.goal: Slip a dependency change into a second workspace lockfile that no decision record covers, riding along with a legitimately-recorded change to the first.

startingState: A repo with two lockfiles. The PR records a change to lockfile A honestly, and silently changes lockfile B in apps/web with no record for B.
vulnerableVersion: n/a — defended by the D5 PR-level completeness rule (changed-lockfile set must equal chained-path set)
expectedVerdict: finding: decisions-missing for the unrecorded lockfile path (verification fails)
regressionTest: tests/decision-verify.test.ts > fails when a second workspace lockfile changes without its own chain (M4)
provenance: RFC-001 §13 M4; closed this cycle by decision D5
